added.summary: The fantasy style pack: lamp-black leather in aged brass with painted panel, card, field, slot, tooltip, HUD, button, divider and knob art, Cinzel display, Newsreader body and Spectral numerals, an icon set and sounds. It dresses every core control and the rpg kit's parts; its selected tab clears 3:1 against the track. Install it with `og style add fantasy`.
